```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: true
if (!exists("MODELS", inherits = FALSE)) MODELS <- c(rigid = "Rigid Models", flexible = "Flexible Models", ensemble = "Ensemble Models")
if (!exists("IDn.target") || !length(IDn.target)) IDn.target <- names(MODELS)
MODELS <- MODELS[names(MODELS) %in% IDn.target]
IDg.target <- IDg.gmdp
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- "mean"
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.Dn")
if (!exists("CAP.MCE", inherits = FALSE)) CAP.MCE <- readCaption("fig.Dn.MCE")
TR.label <- prettyNum(TR.gmdp, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
IDm.target <- IDm.gmdp
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "Newmark displacement figure caption"
)
```

for (IDn in names(MODELS)) {
  cat("\n#### ", MODELS[[IDn]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/Dn.IDn.qmd", stem = .composeTargetStem(paste("dn", IDn, sep = "-")), labels = "rewrite", vars = list(IDn.target = IDn), root = root)
}
rm(IDn)
